frozen_reporting.causal_language_rule: Report overlap and residual counts. Do not claim that repeated outputs or floating-point arithmetic are universal causal mechanisms outside this archived diagnostic population.
frozen_reporting.raw_cheap_state_rule: Use only the exact pre-routing monitor-score tuple consumed by the frozen cheap model. Encode each float by float.hex(); a state is discrete/repeated when the same tuple occurs for at least two distinct examples within the same monitor stack.
frozen_reporting.route_distance_mass_rule: reference_distance = abs(reference_cheap_probability - 0.5); encode by float.hex(); a routing-distance mass point is repeated when the exact distance occurs for at least two distinct examples within the same monitor stack.

implementation_correction.reason: Select prespecified epsilon-grid rows by exact equality. The default absolute tolerance in numpy.isclose aliases distinct small grid values near zero and is inconsistent with the frozen exact grid-point lookup.

research_question: How much of the previously reported 6.12% route dead-band is exact threshold-tie/discrete cheap-output mass versus observed numerical perturbation across a non-tied routing boundary?
